engine: 11tanjung's facilities row — N image cards in a flex row (flex: 1 1 0). Hovering a card makes it GROW (flex-grow ~3.5, width ~17% -> ~45%) while its neighbours shrink (~13%); the active card's LABEL fades in (opacity 0 -> 1) and the active media eases to a WIDER, centred crop (object-position). Default active = the centre card so the row is never flat. transition flex + opacity ~350ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1). Harvested from D_11tanjung (D1).

measured_teardown.move: a CSS flex accordion. Every card is flex: 1 1 0 (equal). An .is-active class sets flex-grow: var(--fha-grow) (default 3.5) so the active card takes ~grow/(grow+N-1) of the row; the other N-1 share the rest equally. The active label fades opacity 0 -> 1 + lifts translateY 8px -> 0; the idle cards show an off-centre slice (object-position 62%) + a tiny scale(1.04), the active eases to object-position 50% (a wider, centred crop). All transitions ~350ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1). JS only moves the .is-active class on hover/focus and restores a DEFAULT-active (centre) on leave.
measured_teardown.cited: 11tanjung D1: 5 cards flex-row flex:1 1 0; hover -> active flex-grow ~3.5 (width ~17% -> ~45%), neighbours shrink (~13%); label opacity 0->1 on the active; the active shows a wider crop (object-position). transition flex+opacity ~350ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1). default active = centre.

grow.what: flex-grow of the active card (neighbours stay flex-grow 1). 3.5 with 5 cards => active ~45%, each neighbour ~13% — the 11tanjung split. Higher = more dominant active.

defaultIndex.what: which card is active when nothing is hovered: 'center' (the middle card), a numeric index, or -1 (none active = a flat row at rest).

card.what: selector for the cards inside the target row.

entry: FacilitiesHoverAccordion.create(target, opts) -> { setActive(i), clearActive(), cards, destroy }. target wraps .fha-card x N (each: .fha-media img + .fha-label + optional .fha-tab mini-label). JS sets the --fha-grow var, marks the default-active card, and on mouseenter/focusin moves .is-active to that card (mouseleave/focusout restores the default). All sizing is the flex engine — no layout math in JS.
law: CSS flex-grow + opacity + object-position (+ a tiny scale) transition only; JS toggles a class + sets a CSS var; NO mix-blend / NO backdrop; NO WebGL; keyboard parity (focusin mirrors hover, cards get tabindex); touch/no-hover -> the default-active card stays (tap toggles). The ~350ms cubic-bezier(.4,0,.2,1) is the 11tanjung curve. owns_pin false, owns_scroll false (a hover/triggered primitive, not scroll).
gate_mode: triggered hover (not scroll). Verify: default-active = centre at rest; on hover the active card width ~= grow/(grow+N-1) and neighbours equal; label opacity 0->1 only on active; leave restores default. Smoothness via the HOVER variant of the probe (arm the rAF meter, then cycle hovers across all cards) — NOT the wheel-scroll variant.
proven: lab: 5 cards on OUR QUADRO renders (pergola / terrace / courtyard / night / roof). Measured live: REST = centre active (widths 12.9/12.9/45.3/12.9/12.9 %, label op only on the active). HOVER card 1 -> [45.3,12.9,12.9,12.9,12.9]; HOVER card 5 -> [...,45.3]; LEAVE -> back to centre 45.3. Active ~45% / neighbours ~13% = the 11tanjung 17%->45% split, dead on. Label opacity 0->1 on the active only. Hover-variant probe (4x CPU throttle, cycling all 5 cards x6): 2/580 long frames (0.3%), 59.9fps -> PASS. Zero console errors. Screenshot (terrace active): the building render in a wide centred crop + 'Приватна тераса' label, four collapsed columns with vertical tabs (matches 11tanjung D1).
